node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-reset-output-typing alone to the exact raw call of node 1.2.1 with D=D_*, t=t_atom, epsilon_R=epsilon_U, B_R=M_1 and A_R=A_U, using the compatible W guards fixed in node 1.1.1. Select its single existential output and call it v_U. That same map simultaneously has unchanged source, target and amplification family, satisfies d_U <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_U and ||v_U(I_{M_1})-u_{A_U}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_U, and is an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_U-isomorphism because the literal u_0 is bijective. Together with the recorded field epsilon_U, these fields form the required def-maincb-reset-state on U; no output of lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation is used.
